# mtncloud_instance_type (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud instance type data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_instance_type" "apache" {
  name = "apache"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud cloud.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the instance type is enabled or not
- `code` (String) Optional code for use with policies
- `description` (String) The description of the instance type
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `visibility` (String) Whether the instance type is visible in sub-tenants or not
